task_completion.description: Agent accesses the Nx Witness VMS API documentation or endpoint at https://localhost:7001.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Browser or terminal showing connection to https://localhost:7001 or the API documentation page.

task_completion.description: Agent performs a GET request to retrieve the list of existing bookmarks.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output or script showing a GET request to /rest/v1/devices/*/bookmarks or /ec2/getBookmarks.

task_completion.description: Agent identifies bookmarks older than 30 days based on startTimeMs that do not contain 'LegalHold'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Script logic, terminal output, or temporary files showing filtering of bookmarks by timestamp and description.

task_completion.description: Agent issues DELETE requests for the identified bookmarks.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output or script execution showing HTTP DELETE requests or successful response codes for specific bookmark IDs.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the IDs of the deleted bookmarks to the specified log file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal command (e.g., 'cat' or 'ls') showing the file /home/ga/Documents/retention_log.txt exists and contains a list of IDs.

integrity.description: Agent interacted with the actual API rather than just creating a fake log file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show network traffic (curl, python requests, or browser dev tools) targeting localhost:7001.

integrity.description: Agent did not simply hardcode the IDs from the task prompt or external knowledge without fetching them first.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent must be seen parsing the JSON response from the GET bookmarks call before performing deletions.
The log file or terminal output should show that bookmarks with 'legalhold' or 'LegalHold' were skipped even if they were older than 30 days.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The API base is https://localhost:7001. The retention threshold is 30 days (older than 30 days from current time based on startTimeMs). Bookmarks containing 'LegalHold' (case-insensitive) must be preserved. The final output must be a text file at /home/ga/Documents/retention_log.txt containing only the IDs of deleted bookmarks.
